scientific_integrity.limitations: Not a census of all genus-three curves or all Howe curves; one geometric rank-one isomorphism class in the stated family, not a unique rank-one curve in genus three.
scientific_integrity.scope: Geometric p-rank, a-number, and rank-one coefficient scheme of an explicitly normalized two-parameter smooth genus-three family over characteristic five.
scientific_integrity.verification: Exact symbolic Cartier, discriminant, quotient and elimination identities; independently implemented GF(25) point-count tests. No independent external audit.
